scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names tunnel,backend,web,ai --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:tunnel" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names tunnel,backend,web,ai,mobile --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,magenta,green,blue "npm run dev:tunnel" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.dev:backend-mobile: concurrently --names backend,mobile --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w web-admin
